title: Canyon Nanobot: A Mechanist's Reckoning
summary: In a rugged canyon, bards and gaffers share tales of oppression and parallel worlds, eschewing the judge and lawyers, as a nanobot interacts with their world. A teenager with a knack for nuts observes. She then faces an unoccupied vault, calculating mathematics, her pertinacious spirit seeking vivacious purpose amidst minimal offers and the vanity of inflation. A hatchet and empty coffins lie nearby. Later, her hand grips an arsenal component, monitoring glottal sounds. Governing geeks and immoral thieves are present, as a ghoul-like watchdog’s rhythmed growl accompanies underwater groundwork for gnotobiology. Finally, a plucky newsboy distributes updates as the refulgence of a tranquil laboratory, overseen by the intuitive teenager, signifies a windfall. A handshake concludes the transformation, hammers and jacks securing a new future.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
